model.name: Task 33.6.3: After moving a diagram element, recalculate relationships and re-route the connector lines to the element's new position
model.description: Tron item-3 (interaction polish). After a diagram element is moved, the relationships must be RECALCULATED and the connector LINES re-routed/redrawn to the element's NEW position - connectors follow the moved node, no stale lines left at the old position. Reuse the existing edge/connector render (R33.3 diagram render), NO fork. Architect scopes reroute-on-commit (drop) vs live-during-drag.
